title: GTA 6 Unlocks in India After 13-Year Wait; US Players Get It at Midnight
excerpt: Rockstar's rolling midnight launch opened in India at 12:00 a.m. IST on November 19 and reaches the US West Coast last. India pricing starts at ₹5,999, the download runs to 212 GB, and there is no PC version at launch.
body:
• Grand Theft Auto VI unlocked in India at 12:00 a.m. IST on Thursday, November 19, ending a wait of more than 13 years since GTA V.
  • The rolling midnight launch reaches the US last: American players unlock at midnight local time on November 19, with the West Coast the final region worldwide.
  • In India the Standard Edition costs ₹5,999 and the Ultimate Edition ₹7,499 on the PlayStation and Xbox stores; the download needs up to 212 GB of free space.
  • There is no PC version at launch and no native PS4 or Xbox One version — the game is built for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Grand Theft Auto VI is live in India. Rockstar Games' open-world action-adventure title unlocked at 12:00 a.m. IST on Thursday, November 19, more than 13 years after GTA V, in a rolling release that opens at midnight local time in each region, according to Rockstar's regional schedule as reported by YourStory and Jagran Josh's launch coverage.

The rollout began in New Zealand and ends on the US West Coast, the last region to unlock at 08:00 UTC on November 19 — midnight Pacific time. For diaspora players in the United States, that means the game opens at midnight local time tonight, a few hours after Indian players started.

What the game is

"GTA VI returns the series to Vice City, in the fictional state of Leonida."

GTA VI returns the series to Vice City, in the fictional state of Leonida. The story follows two lead characters, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos; Rockstar describes a criminal conspiracy that spreads across Leonida after a bank job goes wrong. The game is in English — Jagran Josh's launch coverage noted that Hindi does not appear on Rockstar's official language list. Rockstar co-founder Sam Houser shared a rare public message ahead of the global release, the same coverage reported.

The 13-year gap is the story behind the launch. GTA V arrived in 2013 and became one of the best-selling games ever made; its successor has been the industry's most anticipated release for years, and this week's launch is a console-selling event as much as a game release.

Platforms, price and the fine print

The game launches only on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is no PC version, and Rockstar has not announced one — reports of a PC release in early 2027 are rumour, not a company commitment. There are no native PS4 or Xbox One versions; Microsoft has said the game will also be playable through Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox One and Series X|S in supported markets from November 19, though its announcement does not confirm cloud availability in India.

Two practical catches matter on day one. The download is large — up to 212 GB of free space on PS5 — so pre-loading ahead of the unlock was the difference between playing at midnight and watching a progress bar. And the physical edition is a code in a box rather than a game disc, Rockstar has clarified, so boxed copies still require the full download.

In India, quick-commerce platform Blinkit is selling the PS5 Standard Edition at ₹5,999 across 11 cities, with selected Axis Bank card offers bringing the price to ₹5,749, Jagran Josh reported. The official Xbox store listing for India prices the game from ₹5,999, with the Vintage Vice City Pack and one month of GTA+ included for purchases made before 11:59 p.m. on November 19.

What to watch next

Rockstar has not confirmed a date for GTA Online, the multiplayer component, and has not announced a PC version. The first sales figures and review scores will land over the coming days; the launch-week question for the industry is whether a single game can move current-generation console hardware at the scale GTA V's longevity suggests.
nri_angle: The rolling midnight launch means Indian players unlocked hours before the US, where diaspora players get the game at midnight local time on November 19.
author: Diaspora Desk
